criteria_evaluations.title: Stale next_safe_step reference correction
criteria_evaluations.evaluation: RESOLVED. Stale references to Step 13 in recovery metadata corrected to Step 14. Next safe step explicitly set to WAIT_FOR_OWNER_APPROVAL_OF_STEP14_PLAN.

criteria_evaluations.title: Transport neutrality of core error contract
criteria_evaluations.evaluation: RESOLVED. Core ErrorContract interface is transport-neutral (code, message, kind, severity, details, timestamp, recoverable). Property http_status is classified as optional projection metadata for HTTP transport adapters.

criteria_evaluations.title: Deferred Step15 context and correlation_id handling
criteria_evaluations.evaluation: RESOLVED. Parameter correlation_id is retained strictly as optional string trace identifier in Step 14 payload. Full actor/provenance context, session identity, and authorization tokens remain deferred to Step 15.

criteria_evaluations.title: Deterministic serialization for timestamp and context fields
criteria_evaluations.evaluation: RESOLVED. All timestamp values are required to be ISO-8601 UTC string format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ). Payload serialization follows RFC-8785 JSON canonicalization rules.

criteria_evaluations.title: Strict separation between INTERNAL diagnostic data and PUBLIC client payload
criteria_evaluations.evaluation: RESOLVED. Internal error context (stack traces, root cause exception, internal component paths, query arguments) is isolated in InternalErrorContext. Public error payload is strictly limited to PublicErrorPayload.

criteria_evaluations.title: Fail-closed PUBLIC ALLOWLIST serialization
criteria_evaluations.evaluation: RESOLVED. Public serialization enforces an explicit allowlist (code, message, kind, severity, correlation_id, timestamp, recoverable, public_details). Any key not explicitly allowlisted is dropped fail-closed. Secret-stripping is treated purely as secondary defense-in-depth.

criteria_evaluations.title: Standardized 9-kind error taxonomy validation
criteria_evaluations.evaluation: RESOLVED. Confirmed 9 core error categories (DOMAIN_ERROR, SYSTEM_ERROR, SECURITY_ERROR, VALIDATION_ERROR, GOVERNANCE_ERROR, MODULE_ERROR, INTEGRATION_ERROR, LICENSE_ERROR, INFRASTRUCTURE_ERROR) as the minimal, complete taxonomy.

criteria_evaluations.title: Stable error-code grammar without pre-implementing Step 16 registry
criteria_evaluations.evaluation: RESOLVED. Error code format rule enforced via regex ERR_[A-Z0-9_]+ (uppercase ASCII snake_case). Registry framework for dynamic registration, tombstoning, and cross-module collision checks is deferred to Step 16.

criteria_evaluations.title: Fail-closed mapping of unhandled/unknown exceptions
criteria_evaluations.evaluation: RESOLVED. Native Error objects, unhandled rejections, or unknown throw values normalize fail-closed to ERR_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR / ERR_SYSTEM_UNHANDLED_EXCEPTION (HTTP 500) with generic public message "An internal server error occurred." Stack traces and details are logged internally only.

criteria_evaluations.title: Step 14 scope boundary preservation
criteria_evaluations.evaluation: RESOLVED. Step 14 is strictly limited to: TypeScript contract definition (contracts/src/error/error.contract.ts), error normalizer/validator function, contract snapshot, and unit/contract test suite. Excludes API routes, DB migrations, UI, provider runtimes, Step 15 actor context, and Step 16 registry engine.
